label: Within reach

charts.title: Park acres within reach
charts.subtitle: Open-access park land reachable within each travel time

charts.title: People within reach
charts.subtitle: Residents living within each travel time (ACS 2020–24)

method: Reachable areas are travel-time isochrones from the open-source Valhalla router on OpenStreetMap streets and paths, filled with resolution-10 H3 cells (~0.015 km²). Parks are TPL ParkServe 2025 parks with open public access; the nearest park is the straight-line distance from the starting point to the nearest park cell, searched within ~1.7 km. Tree canopy is LANDFIRE 2024 forest canopy cover averaged over all land (non-forest cells count as 0%), so it understates street trees. Population is ACS 2020–2024 block groups apportioned by the share of each block group inside the area.
